name: dsh-desktop-shell
description: DSH 桌面壳（Electrobun + CEF + Bun 运行时）——迁移自 desktop/src-tauri（Rust + Tauri 2）

scripts.pretest: bun run scripts/verify-toolchain.mjs && bun run scripts/verify-builtin-runtime.mjs
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && hutch electrobun build --env=dev && hutch electrobun run --env=dev
scripts.dev:watch: bun run build:native && hutch electrobun dev --watch
scripts.predev: bun run scripts/verify-toolchain.mjs && bun run scripts/verify-builtin-runtime.mjs
scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run prepare:bundle && hutch electrobun build --env=stable && bun run scripts/sign-app.mjs
